content.about: North Macedonia is a small, landlocked country in the Balkans, with mountains and deep lakes. Lake Ohrid, shared with Albania, is one of Europe's oldest and deepest lakes. The town of Ohrid was once said to have 365 churches. Skopje, its capital, is the birthplace of Mother Teresa.

standout.text: Lake Ohrid is one of the oldest lakes in Europe, possibly over a million years old.

didYouKnow: Lake Ohrid has many species found nowhere else.
Mother Teresa was born in Skopje in 1910.
The country changed its name to North Macedonia in 2019.
